records.canonicalEnglish:
Roy: I see you completed your mission safely. You did very well indeed.
The Federation's subsequent investigation found that Commander Geist of Zajil's military station apparently had close, corrupt ties to Zolias.
Sion: Do you know why they kidnapped Shoko?
Roy: The details are unclear, but it seems they intended to hand her over to Zolias. Perhaps they meant to use her as a bargaining chip.
Joe: So I was right...
Roy: Right? Do you have some idea what this was about?
Joe: ...No, I just can't think of any other explanation. After all, she's such a pretty girl. Gahahaha...
Roy: I see. Well, if that's all...
Now, I'm sorry to send you straight out again, but I'd like you to head to Planet Byuto.
Welda: The mining planet that was turned over to civilian control?
Roy: That's right. There are reports of creatures mutating and attacking people there.
This time you're up against monsters, so feel free to let loose.
Shoko: Understood! Leave it to us!
Sion: You're awfully enthusiastic, Shoko.
Shoko: Well, I'll get to see Welda in action again!
Welda: Hah! Ridiculous.
